t: You are at the Camberwell Cemeteries, two cemeteries close together in Honor Oak, south London. They are known for their burials and their architecture. Since 1855 their records have documented how the Southwark community has grown and changed. Among those buried here is George Cornell, a criminal who was a member of the Richardsons, a gang of South London scrap metal dealers. Kathleen Shackleton, an Irish portrait painter and journalist, is also buried here.
